entities.name: Sulli Valenco
entities.description: A wojek Section Commander of the Ninth Section in 9999 Z.C., one of Agrus Kos's ex-wives, killed and replaced by a lupul.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Wojek whose retirement hearing Valenco attended.

entities.name: Phaskin
entities.description: Shift captain who was to succeed Valenco.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event at which Valenco's replacement by a lupul was revealed.

events.summary: Valenco was killed and replaced by a lupul, revealed during the Decamillennial.
events.quote: she was killed and replaced by a lupul

relations.quote: She was one of his ex-wives
